audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is treated as something you dodge and something Vayne kites backward with — "Kite backward with Condemn", "Keep her near a wall so her own Condemn knockback has nowhere safe to land". Condemn is unit-targeted at 550 range: it cannot be dodged. It pushes 475 units and only stuns (1.5s) if you collide with terrain.
audit.why: Because it is targeted, the only counterplay is geometry — you control whether it is a stun or a free reposition by choosing where you stand. "Keep her near a wall" is backwards: what matters is what is 475 units BEHIND you, not what is behind her.
audit.corrected: Condemn (20/18/16/14/12s, 550 range, unit-targeted): 475-unit push, 1.5s stun only on terrain collision. Fight with open ground behind you.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] says "Silver Bolts proc three times and then stop". Silver Bolts applies a stack on every attack and every Condemn against the same target, and the third consecutive stack consumes them for 6/7/8/9/10% of your MAXIMUM health as true damage — then it starts stacking again.
audit.why: The entry tells a Heartsteel Tahm Kench that the true damage has a ceiling per trade. It does not; it fires every third hit, forever, and it scales off the health bar he is building. That is why this lane inverts at two items, and the current text hides the mechanism behind a wrong one.
audit.corrected: Silver Bolts: every third attack or Condemn on the same target, 6-10% max health as true damage (min 50-110). Condemn counts as one of the three.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] and whys[3] both say Vayne uses "Tumble's invisibility to reset An Acquired Taste stacks" — and whys[3] places this at levels 4-5.
audit.why: Two errors stacked. Tumble only grants invisibility while Final Hour is active, so it does not exist before level 6. And nothing Vayne casts removes An Acquired Taste stacks — they expire on their own, 5 seconds after the last application, one stack per 0.67s after that. She is stalling them out, not deleting them, which means the answer is to commit inside the 5 seconds rather than to re-stack after every roll.
audit.corrected: Tumble is an attack reset on 6/5/4/3/2s; invisibility only arrives with Final Hour at 6. An Acquired Taste stacks last 5 seconds from the last hit.
sources: League Wiki — Vayne: Tumble, Final Hour
League Wiki — Tahm Kench: An Acquired Taste

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1], mid, late and whys[4] all describe "Abyssal Voyage" as a global reposition Tahm Kench gains at 6.
audit.why: That is his pre-rework ultimate. The current W is Abyssal Dive: a 1.35-second channel into a 1000-1200 range blink. Against a champion who rolls every 2-6 seconds, a 1.35-second telegraph is not a gap-closer, which makes the full layer's "W-dive to close on her" the same mistake in a different place.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is Devour; Abyssal Dive is a telegraphed short blink you spend after the slow or the stun has already landed.
sources: League Wiki — Tahm Kench: Abyssal Dive

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] ("Lvl 2-3"), early and whys[2] all finish the level-3 pattern with Devour. It is the ultimate and arrives at 6.
audit.why: The level 2-3 window is genuinely Tahm Kench's best — but what makes it good is the 1.5-second stun landing on a Vayne who has no Final Hour and a Tumble that is an attack reset rather than an escape. Promising the swallow three levels early turns a strong trade into an all-in the player cannot close.
audit.corrected: Levels 2-3: three stacks, 1.5s stun, full auto chain. Devour joins at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warns that stacking maximum health is what arms Vayne, in an entry whose itemisation is built entirely on Heartsteel.
audit.why: Silver Bolts takes 6-10% of maximum health as true damage on every third hit. Health is still the right buy for the frontline role and for Thick Skin's grey-health pool, but the player should know he is widening the true-damage bite as he does it — that is the actual reason the two-item timing flips so hard.
audit.corrected: Heartsteel is correct for the job, but every point of it makes each Silver Bolts proc larger; the lane flips at her two-item timing because of that, not because your sustain fell off.

edits.before: Three An Acquired Taste stacks are online — land Tongue Lash to slow her, auto twice, then the stun into Devour pulls her out of her own Tumble.
edits.after: Three An Acquired Taste stacks are online — Tongue Lash to slow her, auto twice, and the 1.5s stun holds her clean through Tumble's 6/5/4/3/2s window.

edits.before: Abyssal Voyage adds global threat but your real spike is the full 3-stack stun-Devour loop; force it when her Condemn wall is on cooldown so she cannot escape by pinning you.
edits.after: Devour arrives and Final Hour with it — force the 3-stack loop while Condemn sits on its 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown, because it is unit-targeted and there is no sidestepping it.

edits.before: Heartsteel or Sunfire Aegis makes your Thick Skin grey-health pool enormous — Silver Bolts proc three times and then stop, but you have just absorbed half your HP into regen-able grey health.
edits.after: Heartsteel makes your grey-health pool enormous, but Silver Bolts fires on every third hit and takes 6-10% of your MAX health as true damage — the bigger the bar, the bigger the bite.

edits.before: Keep her near a wall so her own Condemn knockback has nowhere safe to land against you
edits.after: Fight with open ground behind you — Condemn throws you 475 units and only stuns on terrain

edits.after: Pop Thick Skin as her third hit lands — Silver Bolts counts Condemn as one of the three, so the proc can arrive a beat early

edits.before: Your Tongue Lash range beats her auto range at level 1, so hit her every time she steps up to CS and begin stacking An Acquired Taste immediately. She has no mobility yet — no Tumble dash at level one means she cannot dodge the skillshot without burning movement, so slow her, follow with two autos, and she is burning Flash by level two or taking a stun into Devour at level three. Respect that Silver Bolts will proc passively on every auto she lands back, but at this stage it is only two procs of percent damage per trade — your Thick Skin grey health absorbs it and you win the exchange on attrition.
edits.after: Your Tongue Lash range beats her auto range at level 1, so hit her every time she steps up to CS and begin stacking An Acquired Taste immediately. Tumble is an attack reset rather than an escape, so she cannot roll out of the skillshot without giving up ground — slow her, follow with two autos, and she is burning Flash by level two or eating a 1.5-second stun and a full auto chain at level three. Respect that Silver Bolts stacks on every auto she lands back and consumes at three, but at this stage that is one true-damage proc per trade — your Thick Skin grey health absorbs it and you win the exchange on attrition.

edits.before: Once she hits level six and gets Tumble's invisibility reset, your stack-building becomes significantly harder — she Tumbles through your Tongue Lash, loses your stacks, and repositions before you can auto twice. Play this window by throwing Tongue Lash AFTER the Tumble lands, not before, so the slow catches her exit rather than her entry. Abyssal Voyage arrives here but your primary value is denying her free Silver Bolts procs; activate Thick Skin before the third bolt lands to convert grey health into a shield and deny the true damage spike. If she Condemns toward a wall, angle yourself so the knockback pins her against terrain rather than you — let her create her own stun.
edits.after: Once she hits level six and Final Hour gives Tumble its invisibility, your stack-building becomes significantly harder — she Tumbles through your Tongue Lash, stalls your 5-second stacks out, and repositions before you can auto twice. Play this window by throwing Tongue Lash AFTER the Tumble lands, not before, so the slow catches her exit rather than her entry. Devour arrives here but your primary value is denying free Silver Bolts procs; activate Thick Skin before the third hit lands to convert grey health into a shield and blunt the true-damage spike. Condemn is unit-targeted, so the only thing you control is what is 475 units behind you — keep that ground open.

edits.before: Two items on Vayne is when this lane flips hard. Silver Bolts now deal percent-max-HP true damage fast enough that your Thick Skin grey health cannot convert between trades, and Blade of the Ruined King or Kraken Slayer stacking means your tankiness is no longer a wall but a timer. Your job shifts entirely: use Abyssal Voyage to peel your own carries in teamfights, not to chase Vayne, and use the 3-stack Devour to delete her from a fight the instant she steps inside your threat range — you will not win a sustained duel, but one clean Devour on a repositioning Vayne is still a teamfight win.
edits.after: Two items on Vayne is when this lane flips hard. Silver Bolts now take 6-10% of your maximum health as true damage every third hit, fast enough that Thick Skin cannot convert between trades, and Blade of the Ruined King or Kraken Slayer stacking means your tankiness is no longer a wall but a timer. Your job shifts entirely: peel your own carries in teamfights rather than chasing Vayne, and use the 3-stack Devour to delete her the instant she steps inside your threat range — you will not win a sustained duel, but one clean Devour on a repositioning Vayne is still a teamfight win.

edits.before: The stun-into-Devour combo removes her from the fight entirely and she cannot Tumble out of Devour's channel — this is your clearest kill window.
edits.after: The 1.5-second stun outlasts anything she owns at 3 — Tumble is an attack reset, not an escape, so the auto chain lands. Your clearest window.

edits.before: Tumble's invisibility resets your An Acquired Taste stacks mid-trade and she can now dodge Tongue Lash on reaction; the lane becomes a neutral fishing game.
edits.after: Tumble only turns invisible under Final Hour, which she has not got yet — but she can roll Tongue Lash on reaction and stall your 5-second stacks out. Neutral fishing.

edits.before: Neither ultimate changes the 1v1 decisively here — Abyssal Voyage repositions you globally but does not close the kite gap, and her Condemn only stuns into walls she controls.
edits.after: Final Hour gives Tumble 1s of invisibility and cuts its cooldown by 30-50%, while Devour still needs three stacks first — her ultimate helps the kite more than yours helps the chase.
